56. On the night before Friday the eve of the holy day of Shabat [=on Thursday night]
the sixteenth day of Markheshvan (26 October 1923) has been killed by murderers on
the way to the town Pahast the young boy seventeen years of age the bachelor
MOSHEH the son of r' CHAIM TZERLIN z"z who drove with his elder brother and with
another man from Pahast to buy cows, and in the evening at the seventh hour they
drove to the town of Pahast and on the way near Pahast murderers attacked and killed
the aforementioned young boy who walked behind the wagon in arrow range, and his
brother and the man who sat on the wagon were frightened and fled to the town of
Pahast. The matter has been revealed to an army officer, and the army officer came and
found him laying in a pool of blood and brought him to Pahast and lived for
approximately six hours, and on the aforementioned day he was brought here, and on
Sunday the eighteenth day of Markheshevan was brought to burial, and the murderer
has been caught and put to prison. He rests by the martyr REUVEN KANTEROVITCH who
has been killed on Monday the second day of Shvat 5682 (31 January 1922) row
"kdoshim" by ... south side.

229. Non-stop tearing over the terrible thing that has happened, "May G-D have mercy
on us", in the year 5682 the eve of Tuesday the second day of Shvat (31 January 1922).
Ten men from the town of Minsk travelled here with merchandise. On the way on the
seventh hour in the evening murderers had fallen on them by the village Dalhinoveh not
far from the town Laseh, and killed seven men brutally and then burnt them. Three men
survived, wounded. They escaped to the town Ozdeh. And these are the dead: a. The
martyr r' REUVEN the son of r' BINYAMIN YALEVITZER twenty-eight years of age. b. The
martyr r' YEHUDAH the son of r' ZEV BAGUSHAV [...] years of age. c. The martyr r'
YITSKHAK the son of r' MENDIL BUNIN [...] years of age. d. The martyr r' AVRAHAM-
CHAIM the son of r' [...] SHULMAN from HARESK. e. The martyr r' REUVEN the son of r'
YITSKHAK HALEVY KANTAROVITCH. Two more men were buried in the town Laseh. The
aforementioned martyrs were buried on Sunday the seventh day of Shvat (5 February
1922) here in the cemetery. They rest by the martyr URIYAH PERELMAN who was killed
on Sunday the eleventh day of Tamuz 5681 (17 July 1921). They were buried according
to the aforementioned order in row "martyrs" by the cave of the "shaimes" south side.
The entire town was shocked over this terrible disaster. May G-D do only good and will
never again rebuke in this way. May their souls be bound up in the bond of everlasting
life among the righteous souls, May death be consumed... Amen.

348. Non-stop tearing over the terrible thing that has happened, "May G-D have mercy
on us", in the year 5681 eve of Sunday the twentieth day of Sivan (26 June 1921) in the
village STAREVEH, which their remains the blood of the family of r' MOSHEH-AHARON
GAL with his son-in-law, among other families. At night murderers fell on them and
killed them in brutal deaths with axes. And these are the martyrs: 1. The slain r'
MOSHEH-AHARON the son of r' YEHUDA GAL sixty years old. 2. The wife of r' MOSHEH-
AHARON the woman MALKA the daughter of r' MEIR. 3. Their son the bachelor YEHUDA
the son of r' MOSHEH-AHARON GAL twenty years old. 4. Their son-in-law a dear man r'
SHLOMO the son of r' YITSKHAK HACOHEN "shokhet-ubodek" LIFSHITS thirty-five years
old. 5. The wife of r' SHLOMO the woman BASHEH the daughter of r' MOSHEH AHARON.
6. Their son the child eighteen years old SHIMON the son of SHLOMO HACOHEN. 7. The
slain r' SHIMON the son of r' ZEV-ARYEH KUTSER "melamed" forty-five years old who
was a children-teacher there. 8. The bachelor AVRAHAM the son of r' YEHUDA-
MESHULAM HANTMAN tailor sixteen years of age. 9. The woman SHEINA-KHAYA the
daughter of r' AVRAHAM HALEVY the wife of r' AVRAHAM HALEVY the wife of r' YAKOV
RIEDER. 10. His daughter the maid BLUMEH the son of r' YAKOV RIEDER shoe-maker
eighteen years of age. 11. The maid KHIEKEH the daughter of YEHUDA-MESHULAM
HANTMAN tailor. They injured her and she lived till Monday the twenty-first day of the
aforementioned Sivan (27 June 1921). 12. The slain r' DOVBEAR PALYEKA from Stary-
Daroh who was found there when the killing took place. They injured him and they
brought him here and on the way to Slutsk he died. They brought all the slain on
Monday the twenty-first day of the aforementioned Sivan (27 June 1921). The entire
city was alarmed over this terrible disaster and mourned them bitterly. May G-D
revenge their blood speedily in our time. Their rest began by the row near the cave of
the holy "shaimes" and were buried in a row according to the aforementioned order
above row "kdoshim" by the cave south side. 13. On Monday the twenty-second
[twenty-first] day of Sivan (27 June 1921) passed away the girl SARA the daughter of r'
SHLOMO HACOHEN LIFSHITS "shokhet-ubodek" who was injured during the killing in the
village STAREVEH and was brought here to the hospital and lived till the aforementioned
Monday the twenty-second [twenty-first] day of Sivan (27 June 1921). 14. On Thursday
the twenty-fifth [twenty-fourth] day of Sivan (30 June 1921) passed away the boy
YITSKHAK the son of r' SHLOMO HACOHEN LIFSHITS eleven years old who was injured
during the killing and was brought here to the hospital and lived till Thursday the
fifteenth [twenty-fifth] day of the aforementioned Sivan (30 June 1921) and were buried
by the aforementioned "kdoshim". May G-D do good and will never again rebuke in this
way. May their souls be bound in the bond of everlasting life among the souls of the
righteous. May their merit protect us. May death be consumed for ever, and may G-D
remove tears from all faces, Amen.

509. On Tuesday the thirtieth day of [Kislev??] Tishrei (12 October 1920) we had a bitter
day, a day of dispute. On this day the lare[?] army left the town due to the Polish army
which entered after them. ...was in town... because of deadly arrows and explosive
arrows which were poured over the town the earth shook, houses were destroyed,
many were injured, also some of the wounded died. At this point we have witnessd
clear miracles, Devine Providence, And G-D's eye [waches] over the pious to save them
from death. Deadly arrows and explosive arrows went over their heads, and did not
reach them. In one room many people sat silently, waiting for G-D's salvation, and then
an internal and hidden voice called them "Quickly leave the room", they have just exit
and an explosive "granat" arrow was thrown into the room and scattered into pieces
and did a disaster to the room and around, but it did not reach the people. Blessed is
the one who benefectors the guilty.

937. Non-stop tearing over the terrible thing that has happened, May G-D have mercy
on us, at the Vienkaishtsineh Hotel, by the town of Ramaneveh in the year 5679 on the
eve of Friday the eve of the holy day of Shabat the tenth day of Tevet (13 December
1918) at the aforementioned hotel where lived there r' PESSACH the son of r' TSVI
HACOHEN GALAND. And at this time the aforementioned r' PESSACH was at home with
his wife and her sister-in-law. And at the aforementioned night at the seventh hour in
the evening murderers have attacked them and killed the aforementioned r' PESSACH
by a revolver, and his wife and her sister-in-law who were also at the house fled from
the murderers outside, and at this time a wagon with two people drove and found the
aforementioned r' PESSACH still alive and immediately they seated him on the wagon
and brought him here to Slutsk, and on the way to Slutsk he died and was left till Sunday
the twelfth day of the aforementioned Tevet (15 December 1918) and was brought to
burial on the aforementioned day and he rests by the martyr the bachelor YOSEF MIEZIL
from Kutsin who was killed on Tuesday the twenty-second day of the aforementioned
Kislev (26 November 1918) row "martyrs" to the south side. May death be consumed for
ever, and may G-D wipe tears from all faces, Amen.

1049. Tears will tear our eyes, water will pour from our eyelids over the terrible thing
that has happened, May G-D have mercy on us, by the town Razoveh in the forest on
the eve of Tuesday the eve of "rosh-khodesh" of Mn' Av (9 July 1918) drove from here,
Slutsk, three men with merchandise to Minsk. These are are the men: The wagon-driver
r' MORDEKHAI the son of r' SHMUEL TRITSANSKY thirty-four years of age, and the
second the eye doctor r' YITSKHAK-EIZIK the son of r' MEIR GOLDBERG thirty-two years
of age and the young woman NEKHAMA the daughter of r' SHMUEL LIFSHITS twenty-
eight years of age. And on the way, eight parasangs after the town of Razoveh in the
forest at the tenth hour at night murderers attached them and tortured them with
beatings and injuries. They died a martyrs' death. Approximately two hours [later] drove
from here three wagons and met the horse and wagon standing on the way. And they
found them all laying in their blood. The wagon-driver the aforementioned r'
MORDEKHAI was found still alive and immediately they brought them to the near-by
village and from the aforementioned village they brought him to Kapuleh to the Balnitsa
and on the way to Kapuleh he died. And they were left there by the place the were
killed till Thursday the second day of the aforementioned Mn' Av (11 July 1918) and on
the aforementioned day they brought them here, and the aforementioned wagon-driver
was also brought here from Kapuleh on the aforementioned day. On Friday the eve of
the holy day of Shabat the third day of Mn' Av (12 July 1918) they embalmed them and
on the aforementioned day 2 they were brought to burial. The entire town was alarmed
over this terrible disaster and they mourned them bitterly. May G-D revenge their blood
speedily in our days. They rest by the martyrs who were killed on Sunday the ninth day
of the aforementioned Iyar (21 April 1918). The aforementioned martyr r' MORDEKHAI
was buried to the town side by r' YAKOV SHLOMO who was killed on the ninth day of
the aforementioned Iyar (21 April 1918) and by him the martyr r' YITSKHAK EIZIK
GOLDBERG and by him the young woman NEKHAMA LIFSHITS. And they were all buried
in row "martyrs" to the south side. May G-D do good and will never again rebuke us.
May there souls be bound up in the bond of everlasting life among the righteous souls,
May their merit protect us. May death be consumed for ever, and may G-D wipe wipe
tears from all faces, Amen.

1151. On the eve of Thursday the twenty-first day of Kislev (6 December 1917) was
killed by murderers at the [...] hotel by the town of Ramanaveh two brothers. They were

house wanted to save himself and escaped from the murderers to a farmer at the near

years of age who was also by her father stayed alive. May G-D revenge their blood
speedily in our days. May death be consumed for ever. And they were buried at row
"martyrs".

2009. Make the words of truth endure, and [to do so] is right, proper and accepted for
us and forever, and it is given to us to be written in a book for everlasting memory that
will never be extinguished. On the fourth day of "khol-hamoed" of "Pessach" of the year
of 5653 (5 April 1893) the Rabbi, the Gaon, G-d fearing, and dweller on the His Name,
mh"r r' BINYAMIN the son of r' BARUKH EBIN of blessed memory commanded before his
death and said and wrote in his will in this language: The house surrounded by a wall
that he has here in the market belongs to the people of the city for holy activities, a fifth
of the "dakhad" belongs to the poor of Eretz Yisroel who sit at the "torah" in Eretz
Yisroel, and four portions belong to the town's needs, things of holiness which are
"talmud torah", "bikur kholim", charity for providing clothing for the naked, and wood
for the poor... , and will be distributed by the "rav" of the town (the Dukhovneh Rav),
and by r' YEKUTIEL HALEVY of blessed memory, and any rabbi that will be accepted in
the town will appoint G-d fearing householders that will be with him to supervise over
this. And the "gaon" rabbi r' BINYAMIN of blessed memory passed away in a good name
and joined his fathers on "Issru Khag" of "Pessach" of the aforementioned year 5653
(1893). And he left behind a blessing, his son, the rabbi, the gaon, perfect in "torah" and
good deeds r' DOV BER of blessed memory, and his grandson the rabbi, the gaon,
perfect and elevated, the son of his son mh"r YITSKHAK of blessed memory, mh"r YOEL
BARUKH, may he live for long days. And from the time that his father r' BINYAMIN of
blessed memory passed away and until now, he acted properly and kept the will of his
father, r' DOV BER EBIN of blessed memory, with the knowledge of his grandson the son
of r' DOV BER of blessed memory, r' YOEL BARUKH, may his light shine, in the best and
most beneficial manner. And now, after this "Pessach" on Wednesday "Issru Khag" and
on Thursday when r' DOV BER of blessed memory became ill, may G-d have mercy on
us, came r' YOEL BARUKH to visit him and found him alive, and on Thursday the twenty-
fourth day of Nissan (11 April 1912) they agreed together and handed over the
inheritance which is the house with the wall on the behalf of the town's and the Holy
Land's charity to the following people's names: r' TSVI GETSOV and r' CHAIM YEHOSHUA
FREEDMAN and r' YAAKOV LEIB LOMBURG. And the three men will hand over the house
with the wall to the town's named charities, an enduring fund, and the "dakhod" will be
divided as aforementioned. And now, on the eve of Wednesday, the first day of "Rosh
Khodesh" of Iyar (17 April 1912), gathered together the leaders of the people, who are
the rabbis of our holy community and all of the administrators of the town's charities,
and the three men mentioned before, and the rabbi, the "gaon" r' YOEL BARUKH EBIN,
may his light shine, and r' NAKHUM SONKIN, the son-in-law of the rabbi, the "gaon" r'
DOV BER EBIN, of blessed memory, to supervise over the matter of transferring the
house with the wall, to clarify to which charities will be given the house with the wall.
And by mutual agreement the understanding emerged that the house with the wall will
be transferred to three of the large and important charities of the town, which are
"Bikur Kholim", "Talmud Torah", and "Somekh Noflim" in our community. And this was
clearly stated according to all of the laws of 'conditions', prior stipulations that must be
satisfied, like the conditions of the sons of Gad and the sons of Reuven, and etc., that
the administrators of the town's charities and the eyes of the congregation, the rabbis
of our community, whomever they may be, are obligated to approve and to adopt the
words of the will of the rabbi, the gaon r' BINYAMIN of blessed memory, in all it's details
as written and aforementioned, and the fifth portion on behalf of the holy Eretz Yisroel,
and the charities of the town, which were mentioned before, will be secured and
maintained, and all of the winds of the world will not move them away from their place.
And expressly stipulated that also the first year after the passing of the deceased the
rav, the gaon r' DOV BER EBIN of blessed memory that the "dakhod" of the house with
the wall will be used for the expenses of the "praves" will suffer only the town's charity,
but the fifth portion on behalf of Eretz Yisroel will arrive to it's place complete and
whole, and also the first year will not remove it from it's place. And they accepted upon
themselves, and upon their offspring after them, the below signed, not to alter any of
the detail of the aforementioned will, even the corner of a "yud" , until the arrival of
Shiloh . And may the deed of charity exist in peace and may great peace come to all of
Yisroel, Amen, Selah. And we came to sign today, the eve of Wednesday, the first day of
"Rosh Khodesh" of Iyar of the year 5672 (17 April 1912), here in our holy community of
Slutsk. In affirmation ISSER ZALMAN MELTSER . In affirmation YOSEF the son of the
"gaon" mh"r MEIR of blessed memory who dwells here in the holy community. In
affirmation YITSKHAK HOKHMARK. In affirmation YOEL BARUKH the son of r' YITSKHAK
EBIN of blessed memory. In affirmation AVRAHAM YITSKHAK... DOV BEAR EBIN. In
affirmation NAKHUM KIPER the son of r' YITSKHAK SANHOK. In affirmation TSVI
HERISH... In affirmation CHAIM FREEDMAN HALEVY. In affirmation [...]. In affirmation

2136. Aha, father, father, the chariot of Yisroel and it's drivers. On Thursday, the 20th
day of Iyar, of the year 5671 (18 May 1911), in the morning, passed away and
summoned to the upper chambers, my father, the rabbi, the "gaon", the righteous,
mh"r MEIR zts"l FYUMER, the son of the "gaon", the righteous, mh"r YOSEF zts"l
FYUMER, who was a rabbi here for approximately 35 years. My father, the rabbi, the
"gaon", mh"r, MEIR zts"l, aforementioned, was taught by his father, the rabbi, the
"gaon", zts"l, aforementioned, on the lap of Torah and fear of G-d. From the dew of his
childhood, every man saw in him that he was created for greatness, and he bent his
shoulder to bear the yoke of Torah, and put nights like days, and his mouth did not
cease from learning, and he did not want to accept upon himself the rabbinic position,
but as his father, the "gaon" zts"l, insisted vehemently before his death "and he should
accept upon himself the rabbinic crown because it suits him, I am sure that he would
accept upon himself the yoke of Torah", therefore, when the congregation of Berezin, a
district of Minsk, approached him around the year of 5629 (1868), he accepted the
rabbinic position of the aforementioned town of Berezin. And he was a faithful
shepherd to his congregation, and he guided them towards the springs of Torah and
fear of G-d peacefully and smoothly. In the year of 5636 (1875) he resigned from the
rabbinic position of the aforementioned town and came here as a "baal habayit" , and in
the year 5638 (1877) he was accepted here to be the rabbi of the town, and in the year
5648 (1887) he removed from himself, again, the rabbinic position, and went from here
to Minsk to live there as a "baal habayit". While residing there, in the summer of 5650
(1889), three honorable people from the congregation of Karelitch, in the district of
Minsk, came with a letter of rabbinic appointment from the aforementioned town, and
asked him to accept the rabbinic position of the aforementioned town, because the
town is small, and his soul will thrive, and he accepted. And he was a rabbi there until
the year of 5655 (1894). And in the year 5655 (1894) he was accepted as a rabbi in the
town of Lechavitch, in the district of Minsk, and he there for a few months, and he left
the rabbinic position of the aforementioned town and came to Slutsk, and resided as a
"baal habayit", and several people approached him from several big towns, and he did
not accept upon himself. And in the winter of 5663 (1902), the people of the
congregation of Lechavitch asked him to come to arbitrate as a Torah judge, and when
he came there all the honorable people of the town greeted him and asked him not to
turn them down and that he should accept upon himself the rabbinic position of their
town, and he accepted. During his residence there he guided his flock faithfully with
wisdom and established several issues: a wood offering, to give wood to the poor during
the winter, and he guided them in the bread, as he established bread for the poor. How
wonderful was the sight when he went himself, accompanied by two honorable people
to gather money on behalf of these charaties. And also he has put his eye and heart
over the children of the Talmud Torah there, and often he would go to the Talmud
Torah to examine the contents of the children, may they live, and he was concerned
over their spirit and body. During Pessach of the year 5671 (1910), he felt himself ill, and
after the days of Pessach were over, when he was ready to go to Minsk, and there were
things be him from the issues of the town which he had to finish, he did not consider
how weak he was, and he consulted with the great Dyanim, may they live, the Beit Din
Tzedek of the Lechovitch community, and he completed the business. He arrived in
Minsk to see the doctors, and when he understood from the words of the doctors that
he is very ill, he did not shield himself from mercy, and he prayed to G-d, as customary
to him, and wrote me that I should come there, and I came, and he told me that he
wants to come here (probably, his whole desire was to be burried here in his fathers'
graves). Aha, I painfully remember the great misery and affliction that my father, the
"gaon", suffered silently, and now sigh was heard from his mouth, as he accepted the
affliction with love. And the doctors were amazed at his strength and patience. The
strength of his Torah and the strength of his memory were with him to his last
moments. He was born on the first day of Chanuka of the year 5600 (2 December 1839),
and he was 71 and one half years old at his death. Besides his greatness in our holy
Torah, in Shas Bavly and Yerushalmy, Safra, Sifri, and Tosefta, and all the midrashim, he
was a shining light in Halacha. His knowledge in the four Turim, and in the four parts of
the Shulchan Aruch, went to the top, and also all the books of Responsa were open to
him. Oh, Hassid, oh, Humble, his wisdom makes his face shine. A man of faith who
despises cheating, engages in constant Torah learning, and explains all difficulties. These
are the words of his son, who writes with trembling hands and broken shoulders, who
anticipates condolences in the city where HaShem rests.... YOSEF, the son of the "gaon",
the righteous mh”r MEIR zts"l He rests with honor by his partner in covenant the great,
renowned rabbi mh"r YOSEF ZUNDIL zts"l of Salant, who was a leader here for
approximately 60 years, one grave away from the aforementioned, row "six” by the
"geonim" to the s"s. See later in the twenty-eighth day of Nisan of the year 5675 (13
April 1915).

2658. On the eve of Monday the fourteenth day of Sivan (27 May 1907) happened a
terrible thing, May G-D have mecy on us, that was killed the venerable mh"r r'
AVRAHAM YOSEF the son of mh"r r' YITSKHAK ADOVSKY LEVIKIER, that was on Sunday
here in Slutsk, and sold merchandise, and twords the evening he drove to his home to
the village of Leviky, and when he drove on the way to Shasy next to Kasharkeh Kutsin
fell upon him murderers and they injured his brain, and the wagon and the horse
returned from the way and went to the way to Soreveh, and he, from his extreme fright
from his head, ran after the horse, and he was bleeding from his head, and came to the
village of Soreveh, and men sat him on the wagon, and brought hinm to Horkeh, and in
Horkeh his soul left him, and natsolstvo and doctors from the village of Babriesk came
and embalmed him, and his sons brought him here to Slutsk, and was brought to burial
on Wednesday the sixteenth day of Sivan (29 May 1907) , and his years were sixty-one
years, and he rests by the martyr who was killed on the first day of "rosh-khodesh" of
the aforementioned Iyar (14 April 1907) row ''five'' to the town side.

3338. On the holy day of Shabat the sixteenth day of Sivan (21 June 1902) passed away
in great pain in the institution here, an elderly man ninety years of age mh"r r' DAVID
the son of mh"r r' AVRAHAM HALEVY LIYEVITIN. This man was all of his days an innocent
and honest man, G-D fearing and enjoyed the fruit of his labour from the profession of a
blacksmith, and during his elderly years he sat in the "beit-hamidrash" of the small town
of Oretseh which is next to our town and studied the Tora of G-D and lived on bread of
the community. And on Thursday the fourteenth day of Sivan (19 June 1902) fell a fire
upon that town and this elderly man went to rescue some house utensils from one man
and he did not manage to get out of the house till the roof fell, and his face, hands and
legs were burnt and he was brought to the institution here and he lay for two days and
on the holy day of Shabat his soul left him in purity and he rests in an empty place to the
south side by MORDEKHAI who passed away on the thirteenth day of the
aforementioned Shvat (21 January 1902) and to the town side by Y' MIKHAL who passed
away on the second day of "rosh-khodesh" of the aforementioned Adar a' (8 February
1902) row "one" against the wall to the town side.

3618. Non-stop weeping over the terrible thing that happened, May G-D have mercy on
us, in the year 5660 on the eve of Thursday the twenty-second day of Tamuz, (19 July
1900) "And the women mourn the Tamuz" , on Vilna street by the Sheftil wall that there
at the bottom of the wall the house of the pharmacist HOPTAIK and on the upper level
lives there the doctor r' YERAKHMIEL the son of ARYEH LEIB from Kovneh SINARUSKER -
a wealthy man. And at this time his wife and her two sons went to Neshviz, and the
aforementioned doctor stayed in his house with his daughter the young girl fifteen years
of age and her name is MINEH, and on the aforementioned night they killed him in a
brutal death, May G-D have mercy on us, with axes, and also the young girl they found
laying in her blood on the bed but she lived for approx. seven more hours because they
smashed her brain, and her jaw they cut with an ax, and she was confused till her soul
left her and an only child she was for her parents, and the police arrested this wicked
gentile, his horse-keeper, and he confessed that he and two of his wicked evil friends,
May there name be wiped out, killed them with brutal deaths, and they took them to
the prison, and three days after this terrible occurence there in the prison one of the
murderers was hung... , Thus may all the wicked evil ones will by lost. And the doctor
was approx. fourty-eight years of age and for several years he was a doctor here, a good
man honest and pleasant to the people, and was brought to burial on Friday the eve of
the holy day of Shabat the twenty-third day of Tamuz, (20 July 1900) and the entire
town was alarmed over this terrible disaster and they mourned them a bitter mourning,
and his daughter rests by her father, in an empty place of two graves, he rests to the
town side by the rabbi mh"r YOSEF MEIR POLIAK who passed away on the second day of
Shvat 5658, (25 January 1898) and his daughter's rest is by her father one place to the
south side by mh"r AVRAHAM ABA SHEPTIL who passed away on the tenth day of Iyar
5659 (20 April 1899) row a' a' to the south side. May G-D do good and may not continue
to afflict us with this, May their souls be bound in the bonds of life with the souls of the
righteous ones, May their merit protect us.

3622. In order that the last generation should know the story of the greatness of our
teacher, our rabbi, the pious rabbi, his holy and glorious name, mh"r r' REFAEL YOSEF,
May the memory of the pious and holy be blessed. From his day of birth all the days of
his life until he was asked to the assembly of above on Wednesday the twenty-third day
of Sivan (20 June 1900) of the year "Oh, the ark was taken captive" the sun at noon
became dark, and the city of Slutsk was in travail. And the mourners mourned him
bitterly "Oh pious, Oh modest, from the pupils of Aharon who loves peace, pursues
peace, loves the people and brings them close to Tora". "Ben Porat" r' REFAEL YOSEF
was born to his father in the year 5589 (20 June 1829) the nineteenth day of Sivan here
in our holy community to his father r' YITSKHAK of blessed memory. "And YITSKHAK
found in that year one hundred gates and G-D blessed him" in a precious son, a darling
child, and his mother ESTER, May she rest in heaven. His parents were humble people,
honest and decent, and also their son they taught to be a honest and decent man, G-d
fearing, who keeps away from evil and one who enjoys the fruit of his labour, as they
taught him the tailor trade. And until the twenty-second year of his life he loved to
listen always several hours to words of Tora as the spirit of G-D was in him from the
days of his childhood. And from the twenty-second year the pious performed the words
of our sages of blessed memory "The tailor should not go out with his needle before
dark inorder he should not forget and leave" the paths of Tora and worship, but he quit
his labour from youth during his younger years and he bowed his shoulder to study with
great diligence and the will of G-D succeded by him because the one who comes to
purify himself is assisted. His sitting in the house of G-D was in the "beit-hamidrash" of
"Vatikin", day and night his mouth did not stop from reciting, and he made of himself "A
man who may die in the tent" which refers to the [tent of] Tora, the Tora does not
accrue, only for someone who kills himself over it. He ate poor bread and measured
water, and his wife, May she live, lived from the labour of her work, and G-D helped him
as in a short while he was able to give rulings in the "halakha" and to learn the issues
according to "halakha", and until his last day, the time of his death, his mouth did not
stop from reciting learning. Over Tora, worship, prayers, requests, poems and charity
done by his body and soul - this was the delight of his will. And all the days of his life he
prayed "Vatikin" and he never made late the reciting of "Shma" and prayer. His sitting at
home was little as he did not leave the four feet of "halakha", Tora and prayer, just for
the benefit of the community to do kindess and peace between husband and wife and
between man and his friend he would always go. Bitter people over any sorrow, that
should not come, came to the "beit-hamidrash" of "Vatikin" to pour out their hearts in
front of the holy rabbi, and he accepted them all with a pleasant face and he blessed
each one of them with a blessing and his blessing made fruit above, and he made
himself available to all the sick people, May G-d save us, to bless them, and in their pain
he was pained. He despised gifts all the days of his life and lived on a little. Only one
man from our Jewish brothers, an honest and decent tailor, his name was r' YOSEF
named as "gaon", r' YOSEF GAON was his name, his pure heart raised him from the first
day that he began to study and YOSEF sponsored r' REFAEL YOSEF, the memory of the
righteous and holy ones should be blessed, he collected money from all the generous
people of our town to sustain his sons and daughters, bread to eat and cloth to wear,
and he did not want to accept the remainder because he did not want to benefit from
his Tora, and with this he did things for the public. Each week his job was to make sure
that the public ritual bath should be clean and he warned the people over the Shabat
before dark inorder that there should not be any violation of the Shabat, G-D forbid.
And his intention was not to eat a bread of shame, G-D forbid. Fifty years he was a great
light to all of the people of our town to direct a smooth path, the path of holiness for all
the men of his age, as any one who wants to attain the crown of Tora may come and
attain it, and by that kings will rule, and honour will eventually arrive. Blessed is the one
who's business is in the Tora and gives pleasure to his creator. And he departed with a
good name from the world, seventy-one he was when he died and the mourners
mourned, May his soul be bound up in the bonds of everlasting life. And he rests in
honour by the heads of the rabbi the righteous r' YEDIDYA HACOHEN KUZMITSER, May
the memory of the righteous and the holy ones be blessed, and the heads of the rabbi
the lord r' ELIYAHU LAMBURG who passed away on the sixteenth day of Adar a' 5649
(17 February 1889) row "five" to the town side.

KHAY' SARA, the daughter of mh"r GERSHON, and her son, the boy YAAKOV, the son of
mh"r GERSHON, and they tortured them with wounds, and were left in his house until
the "sond" came to look at them, and on the fifth of Kislev (20 November 1879) they
moved them from their place in a funeral from people that were from settlments which
were around the aforementioned place, and were brought to here in the morning of the
aforementioned day, and went out towards them with many people, and they were
buried the aforementioned woman by the martyr mh"r YAAKOV MOSHEH, and her
daughter, the girl by her, and her son, the boy, by his sister, in the row "kdoshim"
(=martyrs) , to the south side.

15,379. On Friday the eve of the holy day of Shabat the ninth of Shvat (23 January 1801)
were buried martyrs, eleven people who were killed and burnt on the night of "Motsaei-
Shabat", the fourth of Shvat in the "kretsim Sinieavka" which is by the yard of
Yasiktsits*, that fell upon them murderers in the middle of the night and tortured them
with hitting and injuries, and burnt upon them the "kretsem" in fire, and on the
following day they were all found like a burnt torch, and one of them was found with his
hands cuffed from behind, and on the other was found a rope on his neck, and from this
they recognized it was done by a murderer, and they were left upon the field until the
"sand" arrived to that place to see them, and on Thursday the eighth of Shvat they
moved them from their place with a funeral from pepole of the town of Kapuli' and
Timkavits and from settlements that were around the aforementioned place, with crying
and mourning, and they were brought here on the morning of the aforementioned
Friday, and went to greet them with a great gathering of our community, and were put
by the "pitodastava" to do a "prezinta" and later were buried, the females to the north
side and the males to the south side, and these are their names, r' SHMUEL the son of
m' BARUKH, his wife RAKHEL the daughter of m"h YITSKHAK, his daughter the maid
DOBA, his son the child BARUKH, and the child YITSKHAK, also was living there his
brother-in-law r' ELEIZER the son of the r' YAKOV, and at the time of the killing the
aforementioned r' ELIEZER was not in his home, and were killed his wife and children,
his wife NEKHAMA the daughter of the aforementioned m"h BARUKH, his daughters
four maids, and these are their names, the maid GELY', ITKA, YENTA, HINDA, also were
there [...]* and were killed also, and his name is YOSEF the son of the r' SHLOMO
ZALMAN from "kretsim kamin", next to the aforementioned "kretsim", May G-D revenge
their blood speedily in our days, to the right side of the martyr r' LEIB the son of m'
PESSAKH from Oritseh, who was buried on Wednesday the tenth of the aforementioned
Kheshvan, (29 October 1800) row "martyrs".
